title: Wood Mountain Rodeo Ranch Museum

services.name: School Tours & Programs
services.desc: We provide educational opportunities for students of all grade levels and ages. We can offer school tours jointly with the Wood Mountain Post Provincial Historic Park. Tours of the museum and grounds as well as activities such as adobe mudding, bannock making, rug hooking, rope making, or leather stamping are included and tailored to grade level. School tours can be scheduled from 9:30 am to noon and 1:00 pm to 4:00 pm on the day of your choice from mid-May until the end of June. We typically split groups into two, with one group going to the Provincial Historic Park and one to the Rodeo Ranch Museum in the morning and switching in the afternoon. blurb: The Wood Mountain Rodeo Ranch Museum is a non-profit organization, operated by the volunteer board of the Wood Mountain Historical Society. Our purpose is to collect, conserve, research, and interpret the stories of ranching, rodeo, and homesteading in the historic Wood Mountain vicinity as well as the surrounding greater Wood Mountain Uplands area.
hoursText: Monday to Sunday 9:30 am to 5:30 pm
